xna-type.name: InvalidContentException
xna-type.summary: Thrown when errors are encountered in content during processing.
xna-type.remarks: InvalidContentException is an exception that any importer or content processor can throw to indicate a problem with the current content file. Exceptions of this type are presented differently from all other exceptions the pipeline throws. Exceptions of this type indicate a problem in the content. Other exceptions the content pipeline throws indicate a problem with the pipeline code itself. The InvalidContentException class has properties that identify the content file with the problem, if available.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the InvalidContentException class with the specified error message.

parameters.parameter: A message that describes the error.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the InvalidContentException class with information on serialization and streaming context for the related content item.
constructor.syntax: protected InvalidContentException ( SerializationInfo serializationInfo, StreamingContext streamingContext )

parameters.parameter: Information necessary for serialization and deserialization of the content item.
Information necessary for the source and destination of a given serialized stream. Also provides an additional caller-defined context.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the InvalidContentException class with the specified error message and a reference to the inner exception that is the cause of this exception.

parameters.parameter: A message that describes the error.
The exception that is the cause of the current exception. If is not a null reference, the current exception is raised in a catch block that handles the inner exception.
